P01-08.tool_contract_ready.meaning: Typed tool manifest/discovery/ownership/lease contract; trusted publisher release still separate acceptance.

P01-08.account_schema_ready.meaning: Profile/binding/readiness schemas and no-secret data boundary; live Chrome handoff not prerequisite to schema.

P02-04.canonical_preview_candidate.meaning: Locally runnable shared raster/layout experiment and explicit limitations; full preview/Windows acceptance remains open.

P06-06.model_ready.meaning: Source/resolved cue model, linked mono/bilingual style refs, sidecar serializer and pure tests; no burn-in claim.

P07-02.style_ready.meaning: Style schema/evaluator/raster API with fixtures; full encoded export parity not yet accepted.

P07-08.render_ready.meaning: Runnable canonical compiler/renderer with decode/probe validation; broader style/Windows/live gates remain independent.
